examples.command: my apple rolled away somewhere, can you track it down?

response.rationale: Apples are usually kept or eaten in the kitchen or dining area, but they can end up elsewhere.
Boredom is vague, so several entertainment items are plausible, mostly in living and sleeping areas.

examples.command: my bottle might be in one of the rooms you can walk to straight from bedroom 1

response.rationale: Bedroom 1 has a door only to the living room, so that is the only room that satisfies the description.

examples.command: is there a book in the dining area?

response.rationale: The command names the dining area, so almost all probability goes there.
